newsitem.title: CANADA: MacMillan to rejoin industrywide labor talks.
newsitem.headline: MacMillan to rejoin industrywide labor talks.

text.p: MacMillan Bloedel Ltd will join industry-wide bargaining for upcoming contract negotiations in British Columbia's lumber sector, its union said on Monday.
MacMillan had intended to negotiate separately from Forest Industrial Relations, which has represented all the province's forest companies in past negotiations.

Scott Lunny, a national representative of the IWA-Canada union, said the union and company agreed that MacMillan would rejoin Forest Industrial Relations. They also established a process under which some local issues would be addressed.
Negotiations on a new contract for the province's coastal lumber workers are scheduled to begin on May 5.
MacMillan had wanted to negotiate separate contracts at each of its locations. A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on Monday's development.
The union said the agreement would not affect IWA-Canada's petition before the Labor Relations Board, which seeks to create a joint union council for all MacMillan operations.
